206-751-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

574-6351-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-6351-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

5078-6766-7292-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3899-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3899-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2292-2946-4871-6112.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2292-2946-4871-6112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
997-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

856-3698-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Grinding Station and Quintorius trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as a Food due to Ygra, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-4742-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2308-4050-4871-6097.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
2308-4050-4871-6097.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {1}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

413-628-7191.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Bristlebane Battler enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2781-2921-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3330-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
3330-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

232-1235-2187-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Possessed Skaab tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

874-2866-4986-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4986-5231.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1753-2457-4289-6705.description:

Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

1365-1651-2292-6701.easyPrerequisites: You control two nontoken artifact creatures, one of which does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1651-2292-6701.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving two nontoken artifact creatures persist until end of turn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken artifact creatures, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing one of the nontoken artifact creatures that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Szarel triggers.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the other artifact creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3 once, instead sacrificing the creature who had counters placed on it in step 6.
Repeat from step 1.

856-3698-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Grinding Station and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
When the creature token and the Clue token enter the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers twice, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

147-2921-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-2921-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.

Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

141-797.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-797.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature or artifact on the battlefield.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity
141-797.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature or artifact.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.

Resolve the copy of Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

654-1170-4124-5334-5954.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.

When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-1846-5702-5954.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.

Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it

Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 4.

1597-1909-4486.notablePrerequisites: Gyre Sage does not have summoning sickness, and has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.

Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.

1597-1909-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

3168-3859-4875-5613.description:

When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3750-5340.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five Dinosaurs that do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3750-5340.description:
Declare at least five Dinosaurs as attackers.

Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.

If you control six or more DInosaurs, this combo nets Treasure tokens and colored mana.

2529-2598-2793-4659.notablePrerequisites: Vedalken Mastermind does not have summoning sickness.
2529-2598-2793-4659.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
The Sixth Doctor triggers, copying the Ugin's Nexus spell, with the copy being nonlegendary.
Resolve both Ugin's Nexus spells.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Ugin's Nexus token, adding {C}{C}.
The Ugin's Nexus token is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1624-1860-3646-4827.manaNeeded: {9}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1624-1860-3646-4827.description:

When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, giving Evra base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Evra by paying {4}, causing your life total to become one.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

282-1548.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.

The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of the combat phase, the Port Razer token triggers, exiling itself.
Repeat.

209-2348.description:
Nature's Revolt turns all lands into creatures.
Linvala prevents activated abilites of creatures from being activated.

1267-3423-3753-4600-5241.notablePrerequisites: Gudul Lurker does not have summoning sickness.

During the declare blockers phase, when you recieve priority, activate Sakashima's Student's Ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{U} and returning Gudul Lurker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sakashima's Student from your hand onto the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai.
Deal combat damage with Sakashima's Student, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
Cast Gudul Lurker by paying {U}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Sakashima's Student from the battlefield to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1987-2510-3227-5116.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3227-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

780-864-4050.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying {B}, giving Eternal Witness +2/+0 and a new triggered ability until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {B}.
When Eternal Witness dies, it triggers its own ability from Supernatural Stamina, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Supernatural Stamina from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
